results.title: Salah: Farewell to The King
results.overview: Anfield’s home dressing room is transformed into an intimate theatre to host an extended candid interview with Salah.  Alongside footage of key moments, he relives many of the goals, records and memories that lit up his time on Merseyside and provides fascinating insight into his emotions along the way.  He is also joined on the Anfield pitch by his two daughters to reflect on some of the most unforgettable scenes inside the stadium from the very spots where they occurred.

results.title: Cereal Killer: A Halloween Special
results.overview: A Halloween Sequel to Abraham_11’s Cereal Killer, made exclusively for halloween

results.title: Yoe Gone
results.overview: U Kyaw Khaung, an honest and dedicated railway gatekeeper, takes great pride in his humble profession and values integrity above wealth and social status. Despite financial struggles, he strives to provide for his family and raise his children with dignity. However, differences in values and growing tensions between generations begin to strain their family bonds. When unexpected circumstances bring a mysterious young woman named Bwe Ya into their lives, her presence gradually becomes a source of warmth and reconciliation. As the family faces hardship, misunderstandings, and conflicts driven by pride and material wealth, they must rediscover the meaning of love, sacrifice, and the true dignity of an honest life.

results.title: Who Took My Family
results.overview: When devoted wife and mother Courtney’s whole family mysteriously disappears, she embarks on a desperate search, uncovering dark secrets and dangerous threats that force her to test the lengths she’ll go to find them.

results.title: Choke
results.overview: In this colorful satire, a group of ambitious and competitive women tries to climb the corporate ladder as sinister government practices creep closer and closer. Buoyed by comedic talents, this film mocks our current political climate in over-the-top, blood-soaked fashion.

results.title: Dear Radhi
results.overview: Madhan goes on a one-day date with Radhi, a beautiful girl who works at a spa; the day spirals into a dangerous chase as both the police and a gang hunt for Radhi, ending in a shocking truth that reveals their connection.

results.title: We, Everyday
results.overview: Yeo-ul likes basketball a lot. Her best friends are Ho-su and Ju-yeon. They have played basketball since they were children. One day, Ho-su suddenly tells Yeo-ul that he likes her. She tells him that he is just a good friend to her. Their relationship becomes awkward. Meanwhile, Yeo-ul has a crush on Ho-jae. He is the top player on the boys' high school basketball team.

results.title: Atlas of Disappearance
results.overview: Three relatives of missing people travel a long and complex path in search of the remains of their loved ones, facing bureaucratic, legal and social processes that have persisted since the Civil War. Atlas of disappearance reconstructs what oblivion and repression tried to hide. Through digital maps, archives and forensic architecture, the film illuminates the silent transfer of thousands of missing people to the Cuelgamuros Valley during the Franco dictatorship. Between absences and silences, the film shows the constant struggle to recover the truth, giving name and place to those who were torn from history.

results.title: Fanny
results.overview: The ambitious hairdresser Fanny must survive within the demanding world of the Viennese court. When she pays no mind to the existing rules and moralities of the time, she draws the unexpected attention of the Empress, as well as a public audience.

results.title: Life Is
results.overview: Nora is about to turn 40 and can't stop wondering: what's the point of all this? What was meant to be a celebration turns into a series of unfortunate missteps that push her toward self-discovery. With open wounds, unspoken desires, and a burning past, Nora confronts her family history, death, unemployment, the collapse of her polyamorous relationship, and the urgent need to redefine love, her sexuality, and what she truly wants from life.

results.title: Girl in the Coffin
results.overview: After the death of her mother, Jasmine is struggling to move forward when she finds comfort in Bill, the compassionate funeral director. But beneath Bill's kindness lies a dangerous obsession as he believes they are destined to be together.

results.title: Tanah Sengketa
results.overview: Yuni, a research student, opens a free learning class for children in Kampung Degong. Raka, a local youth who supports her, provides some needed books for the children. Terror begins to haunt Yuni. Despite warnings, Yuni refuses to give up and seeks to uncover the truth behind the strangeness.

results.title: Vocabulary
results.overview: Andy, a young chunky Chinese newcomer, arrives in London’s gay scene full of wonderful dreams. What he finds instead: somewhat racist Grindr bios, slang he can’t decipher (“bog roll”), and rules no dictionary can teach. Over three sex/dates, he stumbles through the unspoken vocabulary of sex, love, and belonging.

results.title: Heritage Minutes: Gander and 9/11
results.overview: "There's only one thing to do here - we're going to ask people to open their doors." It was the day in which Gander and surrounding communities welcomed the world to its doorstep.

results.title: How Not To Try Again
results.overview: After five years of radio silence, Indigo's best friend waltzes back into her life. With no more than 35p to her name, no job, and an incredibly destructive impulse to make everything too perfect, Indigo battles her final chance to save her friendship.

results.title: Breaking Cover
results.overview: A seemingly ordinary back-office worker whose father-daughter hunting trip turns into a relentless fight for survival, and the father's past as a covert operative is unearthed.

results.title: Saburo Teshigawara, Sayaka Shoji, and Rihoko Sato @ Château de Champlâtreux - Sur Mesure
results.original_title: Saburo Teshigawara, Sayaka Shoji et Rihoko Sato au Château de Champlâtreux Sur Mesure
results.overview: The renowned Japanese choreographer Saburo Teshigawara takes over the Château de Champlâtreux for *Sur Mesure*. He has invited dancer Rihoko Sato and violinist Sayaka Shoji to join him in this performance.

results.title: The Time Traveller
results.overview: Taking Beijing Subway's "Time Train" as the main narrative thread, and centering on subway enthusiasts, designers, constructors and operators, the story recounts the construction of China's first subway line, the harmonious coexistence between Beijing Subway and cultural relics, as well as the various changes in subway tickets, carriages and construction brought by the passing of time as trains travel back and forth.
